targets.query: from(bucket: "minecraft") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_event" and r.type == "server_stats" and r._field == "tps")
from(bucket: "minecraft") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_event" and r.type == "server_stats" and r._field == "online_players")
from(bucket: "minecraft") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_metric" and r.type == "ore_rate")
from(bucket: "minecraft") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mc_metric" and r.type == "suspicious_mining")
